==Description==
'''E-45''' will be the 3rd entity you may encounter in [[Section E]]. More information about this entity is shown below.

==Mechanics==
'''E-45''' once spawned will place itself inside a random locker, said locker now being colored differently, and damage anyone who tries to hide in the locker it is in.

==Strategies & tips==

* Check lockers carefully before hiding.
* If any other [[Entities|entity]] is active, check the lockers on your left and right to ensure that none of them contains '''E-45'''.
